method: Guarded stdio integration test, adapter stop-receipt tests, Worker safety test, and a real zero-inference Codex App Server initialize/close smoke

guardedStdio.mechanism: Windows Job Object supervisor with inherited bidirectional stdio
guardedStdio.roundTrip: JSON line written by the controller was echoed by the supervised child

safetyBoundary.rule: Codex App Server may report a result only after a Windows Job Object stop receipt reports activeProcesses=0.
safetyBoundary.missingReceipt: The Adapter throws ProcessStopUnverifiedError; the Worker blocks the task and does not create a checkpoint or transfer write ownership.
safetyBoundary.unverifiedStop: The attempt remains active for later verified recovery or forced cancellation.

limitations: The supervised Codex App Server path is implemented and verified on Windows only.
The real Codex smoke covered zero-inference initialization and shutdown, not a model turn.
Linux and macOS process-stop equivalents remain unverified.
reproduction: bun test src/worker.test.ts --test-name-pattern "cannot verify process stop"
